tools.name: x402_attest
tools.description: Signed x402-v2 attestation of a subject/delivery packet: artifact URLs live, sha256 digests match the bound refs, report coherent with evidence.

tools.name: x402_preflight
tools.description: Preflight-verify a bounty delivery packet before claim/payout (reachability + digest binding + report/evidence coherence) -> signed verdict.

tools.name: approval-check
tools.description: Check a token approval before signing it: reads the ERC-20 allowance (owner -> spender) live on Base and returns the raw allowance, an unlimited-approval flag and a risk verdict. Read-only, no keys, no transaction.

tools.name: dns-preflight
tools.description: DNS MX TXT A records domain lookup with an email-deliverability verdict: A records, MX hosts, SPF (v=spf1) and DMARC policy, CAA, plus a signed ok/warn/fail verdict.

tools.name: base-wallet-lens
tools.description: Base wallet balances USDC ERC20 portfolio snapshot: live USDC / WETH / DAI balances, ETH balance, nonce and tx count for any Base address. Read-only.

tools.name: endpoint-check
tools.description: Check an x402 endpoint before paying it: fetch the unpaid 402 challenge of any x402 URL and verify it is payable and safe - HTTP 402, a parseable x402 v1/v2 challenge, network, asset, payTo, amount, whether the advertised resource URL is the URL you actually called, manifest consistency (/.well-know

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: endpoint-check · Private data: approval-check, dns-preflight, base-wallet-lens · Public sink: dns-preflight, endpoint-check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: endpoint-check · Private data: approval-check, dns-preflight, base-wallet-lens · Public sink: dns-preflight, endpoint-check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
